title: Free Lunch of Image-mask Alignment for Anomaly Image Generation and Segmentation
mechanism: Dual-branch generator produces image and mask together with an alignment regularizer; the trained generator then supplies a generative feedback loss to the segmenter.
adaptation: Generator for inactive and material on 478 cells; its own mask branch replaces the conditioning mask as label, which can absorb label jitter; feedback loss added to PF training.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + Free Lunch samples for inactive. Baseline: row-2 PV-DDPM arm at matched sample count. Metric: CV inactive IoU. Kill: not better than row 2.
evidence: R: IoU above previous methods by 5.03 (Real-IAD), 5.68 (polyp), 16.63 (Floor Dirty). Code github.com/huan-yin/anomaly-alignment stated in abstract, not opened.
